notes: «جميعا عن ابن مهدي» joins Zuhayr and Muhammad on one level
«- قال زهير حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن مهدي، -» is an editor gloss naming Ibn Mahdi in full for Zuhayr's line; read as the same man (rule 7)
«رأيت عمر صلى» is an action in the story, so Umar is not a link; Shurahbil's words are relayed, so he is the last link (rule 6)
